name: PT Martina Berto Tbk
summary: PT Martina Berto Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, sells, and trades in cosmetics and traditional medicines in Indonesia and internationally. It operates in two segments, Cosmetics and Herbal Medicine. The company offers facial cleansers, toners, moisturizers, liquid foundations, body splash colognes, hair sprays, and other liquid formulations; eye shadow, blush on, loose powder, compact powder, and other powder-based products; lipsticks, creamy foundations, and other semi-solid formulations; and masks, body scrubs, herbal teas, and mangir and other natural-based products.
